annotations.title: Check whether Sunflower Clinic serves a state

description: Says whether Sunflower Clinic prescribes medication to residents of a US state, and lists the states it serves. Pass only the two-letter state code. Never pass a name, birthday or health details.

state.description: Two-letter USPS code of the state the patient lives in, for example PA. Use DC for Washington, D.C.
